epic.title: Epic 569: attestation that can fail — evidence, review, instruments
epic.intent_and_why: Make a green qualitative gate mean something by telling the agent what would count at plan time, not by telling it at attest time that it got it wrong. 65 of 105 conditions in the shipped spine templates are check:null.

definition_of_done: A qualitative condition declares, at plan time, what evidence would satisfy it.
A wedged verdict is impossible to express silently.
The journal distinguishes a repaired fail from a gate that never failed.
Every check this epic ships is reachable from a template command check, or allowlisted with a stated reason.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: This epic must not add machinery that is itself unwired.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Measured census plus red-proof pinned to the shipped revision; a report-only check must name its promotion trigger.
good_enough.appetite: Four waves; cleared autonomous through wave 2, stop-and-present before wave 3.

hard_constraints: Report-only is a staging state for an unmeasured signal, never a substitute for adjudication.
Sonnet for every commander and crew slot; escalate to opus only on a double block.
Fix or write an episode; filing an issue is the disfavoured exit.
Do not engage the spec-to-template migration (human ruling; episodes/active/569-001.md).
fixed_decisions: Delivery-first inversion: the built-not-wired guarantee ran first, not last.
WP5 reviewer machinery stays inside 569 as wave 4.
#558 is a design question settled with the human before wave 3, not dispatched to a commander.
The declared basis lands in hand-written templates, not through generate_spine.py.

current_wave.objective: Make the declared basis actually reach the executor on the path that runs, give every override one auditable home, and stop the map index going stale by construction.
exit_criteria: A bare attest with no locator is refused, red-proved against the shipped revision.
The basis is rendered at the active step, so the agent is told what would count.
Every override path lands in one engine-written append-only ledger, and closeout distinguishes a run with overrides from a clean one.
map/INDEX.md is correct by construction at commit, with the hook installed by install_constellation.py and the freshness test unweakened.
All three PRs merged green to main.

issues.title: Declared basis reaches the executor: `because` in shipped templates, rendered by the engine, locator required at attest (#556)
issues.desired_outcome: A qualitative condition states, at plan time, what evidence would satisfy it; the engine RENDERS that basis at the active step so the agent is told what would count; and `attest` requires a resolvable locator rather than accepting bare prose.
issues.useful_now: This is the epic's core value and the thing that turns attest from composing into pointing. Wave 1 settled which path it must land on.
issues.appetite: One commander. Engine mechanism plus basis for ONE template as proof. Not all 65 conditions.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A red-proof, pinned to the shipped revision, that a bare `attest` with no locator is REFUSED after the change and accepted before it; plus engine output showing the basis rendered at an active step; plus one shipped template carrying real authored basis on its qualitative conditions.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the field shape, the rendering point, and what counts as a resolvable locator. Argue the locator definition in plan-alternatives.
hard_constraints_no_gos: HARD: a `because` that is neither rendered nor required is DECORATIVE and is a failure, not a partial win. Precedent: `map_check_note` is documented as 'read by no code at all ... never reaches a run'. Do not reproduce that shape.
Do NOT touch generate_spine.py, specs/, or the spec-to-template migration. Human ruled it out of scope; see episodes/active/569-001.md.
Backfill only where it earns it: basis for one template as proof, then only conditions with measured evidence of loose attestation. A rushed `because` reads as rigor and is worse than none.
A new refusal ships report-only with a named promotion trigger; a widening ships live.
local_unknowns: What counts as a resolvable locator
Whether the basis belongs on the condition or beside it

issues.title: One append-only, engine-written override ledger, checked at closeout (#557)
issues.desired_outcome: Every override path — waive, forced claim/release, consolidate override, skip, amend — lands in one append-only ledger the engine writes and no CLI verb can edit, and closeout reads it rather than rendering a completed runaway identically to a clean run.
issues.useful_now: It is the audit surface every other guarantee in this epic reports into, and #556's locator requirement needs somewhere for its escapes to land.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A proof that an override recorded through each path appears in the ledger, and that no CLI verb can create, edit, or delete an entry; plus a closeout render that visibly distinguishes a run with overrides from one without.
issues.implementation_latitude: Ledger shape and closeout rendering. `_append_trip_entry` (checklist_engine.py:1704) is the working model and its docstring states why it is safe.
hard_constraints_no_gos: ENGINE-WRITTEN ONLY: reachable from the dispatch chokepoint before _run_verb, so no CLI verb can forge an entry. This is the property that makes the ledger worth having.

Known-open and IN SCOPE, deliberately left by commit 244665ee for this issue: waive() hardcodes produced_by 'human', and override_policy.authority is never compared. Fix, do not paper over with doctrine.
A new refusal ships report-only with a named promotion trigger.
local_unknowns: Whether #503's authority validation and #504's closeout silence are one fix or two

issues.title: Mechanize the map reindex: pre-commit hook regenerates and stages map/INDEX.md
issues.desired_outcome: map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl are correct by construction at every commit, so the freshness test never fires on the routine path and nobody discovers staleness after a merge.
issues.useful_now: Measured this wave: three separate reindex rounds across two lanes, and base commit 244665ee shipped its index stale from a human commit. The cost is not the two minutes; it is finding out late.
issues.appetite: Small. One hook script, install wiring, tests.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A proof the hook fires and stages a regenerated index on a commit that would otherwise be stale; a proof it is INSTALLED by install_constellation.py rather than only existing; and confirmation the freshness test still fails on a stale tree with the hook bypassed.
hard_constraints_no_gos: HARD: do NOT weaken, narrow, or skip tests/test_code_map.py's freshness assertion. The hook removes routine friction; the test remains the backstop for --no-verify, fresh clones, contributors without the hook, and CI. If the hook becomes a reason to soften the test, the change is a net loss.

HARD: a git hook is a NEW delivery path and nothing currently installs one. Wire it into install_constellation.py and PROVE it fires. Shipping it uninstalled is built-not-wired, inside the epic that just merged a lint against exactly that.
Regenerate and stage silently per the human's ruling; do not fail the commit.
code_map build measured at 2.9s and deterministic (byte-identical across runs).
local_unknowns: Whether install_constellation.py has a natural place for git-hook installation

wave_evidence.claim: A PR that is MERGEABLE, reviewer-APPROVED and reports 0 failed will produce a green main
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE. PR #645 merged clean at exit 0 into a scratch worktree at origin/main and MapTreeFreshnessTests went 1 failed. The defect existed on NEITHER PARENT. Verify-before-merge in a scratch worktree caught this and #657's six e2e failures; no automated signal the Admiral was watching did.

wave_evidence.claim: There is no automated defence against a PR that reds main
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE, and this is the wave's sharpest correction. .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on `pull_request`, so GitHub checks out refs/pull/N/merge -- CI already tests the MERGE RESULT, not the branch head. It went red on #645 (`gh pr checks 645` -> fail). It was ignored because the last 12 runs are 12 failures: the job is windows-latest only and is failing on autocrlf `git apply --cached ... patch does not apply` and a Windows temp-path `git clone --bare`, i.e. test bugs rather than regressions. A check that always fails carries exactly as much information as a check that cannot fail.
wave_evidence.source: gh run list --limit 12; gh pr checks 645; .github/workflows/ci.yml:13-23

wave_evidence.claim: The 15 unlaunched member issues are all instances of one defect family
wave_evidence.expected: family A, checks that cannot fail, as the epic body describes
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE. The set is 14 (#259 closed) and splits 4 pure A, 4 pure B, 3 both, 2 family C, 1 neither. Family B was already filed seven times and never recognised as a family -- #376's title says 'stale by construction'; #381 says 'the evidence was true and was about something else'; #221 bullet 1 pre-describes the Admiral's own wave-1 baseline error verbatim, with a drill attached, never launched.
wave_evidence.source: gh issue view on all 15 bodies; interrogation q2

wave_evidence.claim: Refresh-requests raised by a commander are answered by the invoker
wave_evidence.expected: the invoker reads `REFRESH REQUESTED:` and relaunches a fresh commander
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE. 8 raised across wave 2 (w2-ledger 2, w2-reindex 2, w2-basis 4); 0 answered. Nothing in checklist_engine.py CONSUMES a refresh-request -- it is an existence predicate that unlocks the start/reopen guard and prints a line. The relaunch IS the refresh. Nothing stranded only because LAUNCH_ORDER.template.md:76 instructs attach-then-start-then-work, the opposite flow from global-everyone.md's attach-then-go-idle.

wave_evidence.claim: The three CommanderSpineBasisFields tests guard the shipped basis fields
wave_evidence.observed: 3 SKIPPED. They pin whole-repo `git rev-parse HEAD` (9d5aac6d), so any commit anywhere makes them inert -- already dead one wave later at 34e80a9e. The skip is an UNPROMPTED family-B guard, the best instinct wave 2 produced, but skipTest means a guard against B is itself a family A, and it reaches only half of #381 (which says divergence means the proof must be RE-RUN).

wave_evidence.claim: A crew dispatched via run_crew.py gets its own door
wave_evidence.expected: each crew binds its own spine or none
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE for spine=None. _crew_door_env binds SPINE_FILE/SPINE_SESSION only when --spine is given; otherwise the child inherits the DISPATCHER's pair and its door opens on the dispatcher's spine. All 7 cli-backend implementers/reviewers this wave hit it and each named it independently in its own feedback. The behaviour is intentional and documented at run_crew.py:1333-1341 as the SAFE fallback.
